english_title: 27. His Supplication for People of Frontiers

phrases.english: 1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.fortify the frontiers of the Muslims through Your might,
3.support their defenders through Your strength,
4.and lavish upon them gifts through Your wealth!
5.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
6.increase their number, hone their weapons,
7.guard their territory, defend their midst,
8.unite their throng, arrange their affair,

phrases.arabic: وَوَاتِرْ بَيْنَ مِيَرِهِمْ، وَتَوَحَّدْ بِكِفَايَةِ مَؤَنِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 9.send them supplies in a steady string, undertake Yourself to suffice them with provisions,
10.support them with victory, help them with patience,
11.and give them subtlety in guile!
12.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
13.give them the knowledge of that of which they are ignorant,
14.teach them what they do not know,
15.and show them what they do not see!
16.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
17.make them forget when they meet the enemy
18.to remember this cheating and delusive world of theirs,

phrases.arabic: وَامْحُ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ خَطَرَاتِ الْمَالِ الْفَتُونِ،
phrases.english: 19.erase from their hearts the thought of enchanting possessions,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ نَصْبَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ وَلَوِّحْ مِنْهَا لأِبْصَارِهِمْ
phrases.english: 20.place the Garden before their eyes, and display to their sight that part of it

phrases.arabic: مَا أَعْدَدْتَ فِيهَا مِنْ مَسَاكِنِ الْخُلْدِ وَمَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ
phrases.english: 21.which You hast prepared for them - the homes of everlastingness and mansions of honour,

phrases.arabic: وَالْحُورِ الْحِسَانِ وَالأَنْهَارِ الْمُطَّرِدَةِ بِأَنْوَاعِ الأَشْرِبَـةِ ،
phrases.english: 22.the beautiful houris, the rivers gushing forth with all sorts of drinks,
23.the trees hanging, low with all kinds of fruits -

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ يَهُمَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ بِالأدْبَارِ،
phrases.english: 24.lest any of them think of turning his back

phrases.arabic: وَلا يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ عَنْ قِرْنِهِ بِفِرَار.
phrases.english: 25.or suggest to himself to flee his opponent!
26.O God, defeat their enemy through that,

phrases.arabic: وَاقْلِمْ عَنْهُمْ أَظْفَارَهُمْ، وَفَرِّقْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَسْلِحَتِهِمْ ،
phrases.english: 27.trim their nails from them, separate them from their weapons,

phrases.arabic: وَاخْلَعْ وَثَائِقَ أَفْئِدَتِهِمْ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَزْوِدَتِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 28.pull out the firm ties from their hearts, keep them far away from their stores,

phrases.arabic: وَحَيِّرْهُمْ فِي سُبُلِهِمْ، وَضَلِّلْهُمْ عَنْ وَجْهِهِمْ،
phrases.english: 29.bewilder them in their roads, turn them astray from their direction,

phrases.arabic: وَاقْـطَعْ عَنْهُمُ الْمَدَدَ وَانْقُصْ مِنْهُمُ الْعَدَدَ،
phrases.english: 30.cut off reinforcements from them, chop them down in numbers,

phrases.arabic: وَامْلاْ أَفْئِدَتَهُمُ الرُّعْبَ، وَاقْبِضْ أَيْـدِيَهُمْ عَنِ البَسْطِ،
phrases.english: 31.fill their hearts with terror, hold back their hands from stretching forth,
32.tie back their tongues from speaking,

phrases.arabic: وَشَرِّدْ بهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ، وَنَكِّلْ بِهِمْ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ،
phrases.english: 33."scatter by them the ones behind them" (8:57), make them a lesson for those beyond them,
34.and through their degradation cut off the hopes of those who come after them!
35.O God, make the wombs of their women barren
36.dry up the loins of their men,
37.cut off the breeding of their mounts and their cattle,

phrases.arabic: لاَ تَأذَنْ لِسَمَائِهِمْ فِي قَطْر وَلاَ لارْضِهِمْ فِي نَبَات.
phrases.english: 38.and permit not their sky to rain or their earth to grow!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَقَوِّ بِذَلِكَ مِحَالَّ أَهْلِ الإسْلاَمِ ،
phrases.english: 39.O God, through that strengthen the prowess of the People of Islam,

phrases.arabic: وَحَصِّنْ بِهِ دِيَارَهُمْ ، وَثَمِّرْ بِـهِ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ،
phrases.english: 40.fortify their cities, increase their properties,

phrases.arabic: وَفَرِّغْهُمْ عَنْ مُحَارَبَتِهِمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَعَنْ مُنَابَذَتِهِمْ للْخَلْوَةِ بِكَ،
phrases.english: 41.give them ease from their fighting to worship You and from their warfare to be alone with You,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لا يُعْبَدَ فِي بِقَاعِ الارْضِ غَيْرُكَ
phrases.english: 42.so that none will be worshipped in the regions of the earth but You

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ  تُعَفَّرَ لاَِحَد مِنْهُمْ جَبْهَةٌ دُونَكَ.
phrases.english: 43.and no forehead of theirs may be rubbed in dust for less than You!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اغزُ بِكُلِّ نَـاحِيَـة مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
phrases.english: 44.O God, send out the Muslims of every region on raids
45.against the idolaters who face them!
46.Reinforce them with angels in ranks from You,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى يَكْشِفُـوهُمْ إلَى مُنْقَطَعِ التُّـرابِ قَتْـلاً فِي أَرْضِكَ
phrases.english: 47.till the idolaters are routed by them to the end of the land, slain in Your earth

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْراً أَوْ يُقِرُّوا بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الَّذِي لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ
phrases.english: 48.or taken captive, or till they admit that You art God, other than whom there is no god,
49.You alone, who hast no associate!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذَلِكَ أَعْدَاءَكَ فِي أَقْطَارِ الْبِلاَدِ
phrases.english: 50.O God, include in this Your enemies in the regions of the lands,

phrases.arabic: مِنَ الْهِنْدِ وَالرُّومِ وَالتُّـرْكِ وَالْخَزَرِ وَالْحَبَشِ
phrases.english: 51.the Indians, the Byzantines, the Turks, the Khazars, the Abyssinians,
52.the Nubians, the Zanjis, the Slavs, the Daylamites,

phrases.arabic: وَسَائِرِ أُمَمِ الشِّرْكِ الَّذِي تَخْفَى أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ وَصِفاتُهُمْ،
phrases.english: 53.and the rest of the idol-worshipping nations, those whose names and attributes are concealed,

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَأَشْرَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 54.but whom You countest in Your cognizance and overseest through Your power!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالمُشْرِكِينَ عَنْ تَنَاوُلِ أَطْرَافِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ،
phrases.english: 55.O God, distract the idolaters from reaching for the borders of the Muslims through the idolaters,
56.bar them from cutting them down through being cut down,
57.and hold them back from massing together against them through dissension!
58.O God, empty their hearts of security

phrases.arabic: وَأَبْدَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُوَّةِ وَأَذْهِلْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الاحْتِيَالِ
phrases.english: 59.and their bodies of strength, distract their hearts from thinking of stratagems,
60.make their limbs too feeble for clashing with men,
61.make them too cowardly for contending with champions,
62.send against them a troop of Your angels

phrases.arabic: بِبَأس مِنْ بَأْسِكَ كَفِعْلِكَ يَوْمَ بَدْر
phrases.english: 63.with some of Your severity as You didst on the Day of Badr,

phrases.arabic: تَقْطَعُ بِهِ دَابِرَهُمْ وَتَحْصُدُ بِهِ شَوْكَتَهُمْ،
phrases.english: 64.so that through it You mayest cut off their roots, harvest their thorns,
65.and disperse their number!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَامْزُجْ مِيَاهَهُمْ بِالْوَبَاءِ وَأطْعِمَتَهُمْ بِالأَدْوَاءِ
phrases.english: 66.O God, mix their waters with pestilence and their foods with maladies,

phrases.arabic: وَارْمِ بِلاَدَهُمْ بِالْخُسُوفِ وَأَلِـحَّ عَلَيْهَا بِـالْقُذُوفِ وَافْـرَعْهَا بِالْمُحُولِ.
phrases.english: 67.hurl down their cities, harass them with peltings, hinder them through drought,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ مِيَرَهُمْ فِي أَحَصِّ أَرْضِكَ وَأَبْعَـدِهَا عَنْهُمْ،
phrases.english: 68.place their supplies in the most ill-omened part of Your earth and the farthest from them,

phrases.arabic: وَامْنَـعْ حُصُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ، أَصِبْهُمْ بِالْجُوعِ الْمُقِيمِ وَالسُّقْمِ الالِيمِ.
phrases.english: 69.bar them from its fortresses, and strike them with constant hunger and painful illness!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا غَاز  غَزَاهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ
phrases.english: 70.O God, if a warrior from the people of Your creed wars against them

phrases.arabic: أَوْ مُجَاهِد جَاهَدَهُمْ مِنْ أَتْبَاعِ سُنَّتِكَ لِيَكُونَ دِينُكَ الاعْلَى
phrases.english: 71.or a struggler from the followers of Your prescriptions struggles against them so that Your religion may be the highest,

phrases.arabic: وَحِزْبُكَ الأقوَى وَحَظُّكَ الأوْفَى فَلَقِّهِ الْيُسْرَ،
phrases.english: 72.Your party the strongest, and Your share the fullest, cast ease to him,
73.arrange his affair, attend to him by granting success,

phrases.arabic: وَتَخَيَّرْ لَهُ الأصْحَابَ، وَاسْتَقْوِ لَهُ الظَّهْرَ،
phrases.english: 74.select for him his companions, strengthen his back,

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْبِغْ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّفَقَةِ وَمَتِّعْهُ بِالنَّشَاطِ،
phrases.english: 75.lavish upon him livelihood, give him enjoyment of joyous vitality,

phrases.arabic: وَأَطْفِ عَنْهُ حَرَارَةَ الشَّوْقِ، وَأَجِرْهُ مِنْ غَمِّ الْوَحْشَةِ،
phrases.english: 76.cool for him the heat of yearning, give him sanctuary from the gloom of loneliness,

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْسِهِ ذِكْرَ الاهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَأَثُرْ لَهُ حُسْنَ النِّيَّةِ وَتَوَلَّه بِالْعَافِيَةِ،
phrases.english: 77.make him forget the remembrance of wife and child, pass along to him an excellent intention, attend to him with well-being,
78.make safety his companion, release him from cowardice,

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْهُ الْجُرْأَةَ وَارْزُقْهُ الشِّدَّةَ وَأَيِّدْهُ بِالنُّصْرَةِ،
phrases.english: 79.inspire him with boldness, provide him with strength, support him with help,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلِّمْهُ السِّيَرَ وَالسُّنَنَ، وَسَدِّدْهُ فِي الْحُكْمِ،
phrases.english: 80.teach him right conduct and the norms of the Sunna, point him straight in judgement,

phrases.arabic: وَاعْزِلْ عَنْهُ الرِّياءَ، وخَلِّصْهُ مِنَ السُّمْعَةِ
phrases.english: 81.remove from him hypocrisy, purify him from seeking fame,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ فِكْرَهُ وَذِكْرَهُ وَظَعْنَهُ وَإقَامَتَهُ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ،
phrases.english: 82.and make his thinking and remembrance, his departing and his staying, be in You and for You!

phrases.arabic: فَإذا صَافَّ عَدُوَّكَ وَعَدُوَّهُ فَقَلِّلْهُمْ فِي عَيْنِهِ
phrases.english: 83.When he stands in ranks before Your enemy and his enemy, make them few in his eye,
84.diminish their importance in his heart,

phrases.arabic: وَأَدِلْ لَهُ مِنْهُـمْ وَلاَ تُدِلْهُمْ مِنْهُ
phrases.english: 85.give him a turn to prevail over them, not them a turn to prevail over him!

phrases.arabic: فَإنْ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَقَضَيْتَ لَهُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ
phrases.english: 86.But if You sealest him with felicity and decreest for him martyrdom,
87.then let it be after he has exterminated Your enemies by slaying,
88.captivity has afflicted them,
89.the borders of the Muslims are secure,
90.and Your enemy has turned his back in flight!
91.O God, and if a Muslim should

phrases.arabic: خَلَفَ غَازِياً أَوْ مُرَابِطاً فِي دَارِهِ
phrases.english: 92.take the place of a warrior or a soldier in his home,
93.attend to those left behind in his absence,
94.help him with a portion of his property,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ أَمَدَّهُ بِعِتَاد، أَوْ شَحَذَهُ عَلَى جِهَاد،
phrases.english: 95.assist him with equipment, hone him for the struggle,
96.send along with him a supplication for his purpose,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ رَعَى لَهُ مِنْ وَرَآئِهِ حُرْمَةً.
phrases.english: 97.or guard his honour in his absence,
98.reward him with the like of his reward

phrases.arabic: وَزْناً بِوَزْن وَمِثْلاً بِمِثْل وَعَوِّضْهُ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ
phrases.english: 99.measure for measure, like for like, and recompense him for his act

phrases.arabic: عِوَضاً حَاضِراً يَتَعَجَّلُ بِهِ نَفْعَ مَا قَدَّمَ،
phrases.english: 100.with an immediate compensation through which he will hasten to the profit of what he has sent forth

phrases.arabic: وَسُرُورَ مَا أَتَى به، إلَى أَنْ  يَنْتَهِيَ بِهِ الْوَقْتُ
phrases.english: 101.and the joy of what he has given, till the present moment takes him
102.to the bounty You hast granted to him
103.and the generosity You hast prepared for him!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا  مُسْلِم أَهَمَّهُ أَمْرُ الإِسْلاَمِ
phrases.english: 104.O God, and if the affair of Islam should worry a Muslim
105.and the alliance of the idolaters' against Islam should grieve him,
106.so that he has the intention to go to war and is about to enter the struggle,

phrases.arabic: فَقَعَدَ بِـهِ ضَعْفٌ أَوْ أَبطَأَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ،
phrases.english: 107.but frailty keeps him seated, neediness keeps him waiting,
108.a mishap delays him,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ عَرَضَ لَهُ دُونَ إرَادَتِهِ  مَانِعٌ،
phrases.english: 109.or an obstruction prevents him from his wish,
110.write his name among the worshipers,
111.make incumbent for him the reward of the strugglers,
112.and place him among the ranks of the martyrs and the righteous!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
phrases.english: 113.O God, bless Muhammad, Your slave and Your messenger,

phrases.arabic: وَآلِ مُحَمَّد صَلاَةً عَالِيَةً عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
phrases.english: 114.and the Household of Muhammad, with a blessing high above all other blessings,
115.towering beyond all other salutations,
116.a blessing whose end is never reached
117.and whose number is never cut off,
118.like the most perfect of Your blessings that has passed
119.to any one of Your friends!
120.You art All-kind, Praiseworthy,
121.the Originator who takes back again,
122.Accomplisher of what You desirest.
